Government Revises CBFC Guidelines for Film Certification

The Indian government has issued new guidelines to the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC), marking the first revision in 35 years. The updated rules introduce five new categories for film classification, including 'violence' and 'anti-national' content. These changes could potentially affect upcoming film releases, with reports suggesting that Salman Khan's film 'Matrubhoomi' might face scrutiny under the new framework.
